description.narrative:
Swedac and SIS will support Ukraine to:
- Maintain the most important aspects of QI (Quality Infrastructure) during the war to sustain trade and vital public services. As a result, it will increase export to the EU during the war.
- Strengthening the Ukrainian QI after the war to promote trade and support a green reconstruction. As a result, the short-term increase of export to EU and investment in export-oriented facilities. These investments will lead to increasing in export in the long term.
- Support the institutions within the QI in Ukraine in their adaptation to, and integration with, the EU. Integrated institutions will increase trust from local investors, as well as from foreign investors. It will lead to rising in long-term investment in export-oriented facilities.

Ukraina är i en EU-närmandeprocess. Kvalitetsinfrastruktur (KI) är en betydelsefull faktor för den ekonomiska integreringen. Swedac och SIS kommer att stödja Ukraina med att upprätthålla de viktigaste aspekterna av KI medan kriget pågår för att upprätthålla handel och viktiga offentliga tjänster; att stärka den ukrainska KI efter kriget för att främja handel och stödja en grön återuppbyggnad; att stödja institutionerna inom KI i Ukraina i deras anpassning till och integration med EU.

Ukraine is in the process of EU integration. Quality infrastructure (QI) is a significant factor in economic integration. Swedac and SIS will support Ukraine to maintain the most important aspects of QI while the war continues to sustain trade and vital public services; strengthening the Ukrainian QI after the war to promote trade and support a green reconstruction; support the institutions within the QI in Ukraine in their adaptation to, and integration with, the EU.

Overall, during the inception phase, the partners achieved the desired results: they prepared the final version of the project documents and carried out a number of activities to achieve the final goals of the project.
Some activities did not implemented partly due to the complexity of coordination between a large number of beneficiaries and partners, due to security and organizational challenges in Ukraine.
The main task of the inception phase - the preparation of a full-fledged project program - was completed. The budget, activity plan, and risk matrix were completed in accordance with Sida standards and correspond to the current context.
Project documents were developed together with beneficiaries and other stakeholders to make them as relevant and realistic as possible
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
